entities.name: What is the highest eligible free rate for K-12 students in the schools in Alameda County?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT MAX(T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL

entities.name: Please list the lowest three eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 in continuation schools.

properties.sql: SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School' AND `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3

entities.name: For the school with the highest average score in Reading in the SAT test, what is its FRPM count for students aged 5-17?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` + T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

entities.name: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT MAX(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3
  AND T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
  AND T2.NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL
  AND T2.NumTstTakr <> 0

entities.name: Please list the phone numbers of the schools with the top 3 SAT excellence rate.

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3

entities.name: List the top five schools, by descending order, from the highest to the lowest, the most number of Enrollment (Ages 5-17). Please give their NCES school identification number.

properties.sql:
SELECT T1.NCESSchool
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5

entities.name: Which active district has the highest average score in Reading?

properties.sql: SELECT T1.District FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Active' ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1

entities.name: How many schools in merged Alameda have number of test takers less than 100?

properties.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100 AND T1.County = 'Lake'

entities.name: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.

properties.sql: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null

entities.name: How many schools in Fresno (directly funded) have number of test takers not more than 250?

properties.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND T1.`County Name` = 'Fresno' AND T2.NumTstTakr <= 250

entities.name: What is the phone number of the school that has the highest average score in Math?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: Please list the zip code of all the charter schools in Fresno County Office of Education.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1

entities.name: How many schools in Amador which the Low Grade is 9 and the High Grade is 12?

properties.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Amador'
  AND T1.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND T1.`High Grade` = '12'

entities.name: In Los Angeles how many schools have more than 500 free meals but less than 700 free or reduced price meals for K-12?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

entities.name: Which school in Contra Costa has the highest number of test takers?

properties.sql: SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' AND sname IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1

entities.name: List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.

properties.sql: SELECT T1.School, T1.Street FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

entities.name: Give the names of the schools with the percent eligible for free meals in K-12 is more than 0.1 and test takers whose test score is greater than or equal to 1500?

properties.sql:
SELECT T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T2.NumGE1500 > 0

entities.name: Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT is grater than 400, what is the funding type of these schools?

properties.sql: SELECT T1.sname, T2.`Charter Funding Type` FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%' GROUP BY T1.sname, T2.`Charter Funding Type` HAVING CAST(SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400

entities.name: State the names and full communication address of high schools in Monterey which has more than 800 free or reduced price meals for ages 15-17?

properties.sql: SELECT T1.`School Name`, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'

entities.name: What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after 1991 or closed before 2000? List the school names along with the score. Also, list the communication number of the schools if there is any.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.Phone FROM schools AS T2 LEFT JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) > '1991' OR strftime('%Y', T2.ClosedDate) < '2000'

entities.name: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded')

entities.name: When did the first-through-twelfth-grade school with the largest enrollment open?

properties.sql:
SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`School Type` = 'K-12 Schools (Public)'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the unabbreviated mailing street address of the school with the highest FRPM count for K-12 students?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T2.MailStreet
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: Which cities have the top 5 lowest enrollment number for students in grades 1 through 12?

properties.sql: SELECT T2.City FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode GROUP BY T2.City ORDER BY SUM(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC LIMIT 5

entities.name: What is the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools with the highest enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

entities.name: What is the eligible free or reduced price meal rate for the top 5 schools in grades 1-12 with the highest free or reduced price meal count of the schools with the ownership code 66?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOC = '66'
  AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
  AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` <> 0
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

entities.name: What is the free rate for students between the ages of 5 and 17 at the school run by Kacey Gibson?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

entities.name: What is the administrator's email address of the chartered school with the fewest students enrolled in grades 1 through 12?

properties.sql: SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1

entities.name: Under whose administration is the school with the highest number of students scoring 1500 or more on the SAT? Indicate their full names.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.AdmFName1, T2.AdmLName1, T2.AdmFName2, T2.AdmLName2, T2.AdmFName3, T2.AdmLName3 FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1

entities.name: What are the webpages for the Los Angeles County school that has between 2,000 and 3,000 test takers?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T1.Website
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000

entities.name: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno'
  AND T1.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'

entities.name: Please list the phone numbers of the direct charter-funded schools that are opened after 2000/1/1.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.Phone FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

entities.name: What is the telephone number for the school with the lowest average score in reading in Fresno Unified?

properties.sql:
SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.District = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND T1.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.

properties.sql: SELECT School FROM (SELECT T2.School,T1.AvgScrRead, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T2.County ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' ) ranked_schools WHERE rnk <= 5

entities.name: What is the type of education offered in the school who scored the highest average in Math?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T2.EdOpsName
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the average math score of the school with the lowest average score for all subjects, and in which county is it located?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T1.AvgScrMath AS AvgMathScore,
       T3.County
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T3 ON T1.cds = T3.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND T1.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
  AND T1.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 ASC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the average writing score of the school who has the highest number of test takers whose total SAT sscores are greater or equal to 1500? Indicate the city to where the school is situated.

properties.sql:
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci Ulrich? List the schools and the corresponding average writing scores.

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE (T2.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T2.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T2.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')

entities.name: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?

properties.sql: SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

entities.name: Which different county has the most number of closed schools? Please provide the name of each school as well as the closure date.

properties.sql: SELECT DISTINCT County, School, ClosedDate FROM schools WHERE County = ( SELECT County FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Closed' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(School) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND StatusType = 'Closed' AND school IS NOT NULL

entities.name: In which mailing street address can you find the school that has the lowest average score in reading? Also give the school's name.

properties.sql:
SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the total number of schools whose total SAT scores are greater or equal to 1500 whose mailing city is Lakeport?

properties.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumGE1500 > 0 AND T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

entities.name: How many test takers are there at the school/s whose mailing city address is in Fresno?

properties.sql:
SELECT T1.NumTstTakr
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'

entities.name: Of the schools with a mailing state address in California, what is the ratio of the schools located in the county of Colusa against the school located in the county of Humboldt?

properties.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA'

entities.name: Of all the schools with a mailing state address in California, how many are active in San Joaquin city?

properties.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND City = 'San Joaquin'
  AND StatusType = 'Active'

entities.name: What is the phone number and extension number for the school that had the 333rd highest average writing score?

properties.sql:
SELECT T2.Phone, T2.Ext
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332

entities.name: What is the phone number and extension number for the school with the zip code 95203-3704? Indicate the school's name.

properties.sql:
SELECT T2.Phone, T2.Ext, T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Zip = '95203-3704'

entities.name: Among the schools with the SAT test takers of over 500, please list the schools that are magnet schools or offer a magnet program.

FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

entities.name: What are the websites for all the partially virtual chartered schools located in San Joaquin?

properties.sql: SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Joaquin' AND Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1

entities.name: How many chartered schools located in the city of Hickman are owned by the Elementary School District?

properties.sql: SELECT COUNT(School) FROM schools WHERE DOC = 52 AND Charter = 1 AND City = 'Hickman'

entities.name: In chartered schools with charter number 00D2, what are the names of all the administrators? Include the name of the school and the city to which it belongs

       AdmLName1,
       School,
       City
FROM schools

entities.name: What is the total number of schools with a mailing city in Hickman belonging to the charter number 00D4?

FROM schools
